verses.text: Listen, sons, to a father’s instruction. Pay attention and know understanding;
lines: Listen, sons, to a father’s instruction.
Pay attention and know understanding;

verses.text: for I give you sound learning. Don’t forsake my law.
lines: for I give you sound learning.
Don’t forsake my law.

verses.text: For I was a son to my father, tender and an only child in the sight of my mother.
lines: For I was a son to my father,
tender and an only child in the sight of my mother.

verses.text: He taught me, and said to me: “Let your heart retain my words. Keep my commandments, and live.
lines: He taught me, and said to me:
“Let your heart retain my words.
Keep my commandments, and live.

verses.text: Get wisdom. Get understanding. Don’t forget, and don’t deviate from the words of my mouth.
lines: Get wisdom.
Get understanding.
Don’t forget, and don’t deviate from the words of my mouth.

verses.text: Don’t forsake her, and she will preserve you. Love her, and she will keep you.
lines: Don’t forsake her, and she will preserve you.
Love her, and she will keep you.

verses.text: Wisdom is supreme. Get wisdom. Yes, though it costs all your possessions, get understanding.
lines: Wisdom is supreme.
Get wisdom.
Yes, though it costs all your possessions, get understanding.

verses.text: Esteem her, and she will exalt you. She will bring you to honor when you embrace her.
lines: Esteem her, and she will exalt you.
She will bring you to honor when you embrace her.

verses.text: She will give to your head a garland of grace. She will deliver a crown of splendor to you.”
lines: She will give to your head a garland of grace.
She will deliver a crown of splendor to you.”

verses.text: Listen, my son, and receive my sayings. The years of your life will be many.
lines: Listen, my son, and receive my sayings.
The years of your life will be many.

verses.text: I have taught you in the way of wisdom. I have led you in straight paths.
lines: I have taught you in the way of wisdom.
I have led you in straight paths.

verses.text: When you go, your steps will not be hampered. When you run, you will not stumble.
lines: When you go, your steps will not be hampered.
When you run, you will not stumble.

verses.text: Take firm hold of instruction. Don’t let her go. Keep her, for she is your life.
lines: Take firm hold of instruction.
Don’t let her go.
Keep her, for she is your life.

verses.text: Don’t enter into the path of the wicked. Don’t walk in the way of evil men.
lines: Don’t enter into the path of the wicked.
Don’t walk in the way of evil men.

verses.text: Avoid it, and don’t pass by it. Turn from it, and pass on.
lines: Avoid it, and don’t pass by it.
Turn from it, and pass on.

verses.text: For they don’t sleep unless they do evil. Their sleep is taken away, unless they make someone fall.
lines: For they don’t sleep unless they do evil.
Their sleep is taken away, unless they make someone fall.

verses.text: For they eat the bread of wickedness and drink the wine of violence.
lines: For they eat the bread of wickedness
and drink the wine of violence.

verses.text: But the path of the righteous is like the dawning light that shines more and more until the perfect day.
lines: But the path of the righteous is like the dawning light
that shines more and more until the perfect day.

verses.text: The way of the wicked is like darkness. They don’t know what they stumble over.
lines: The way of the wicked is like darkness.
They don’t know what they stumble over.

verses.text: My son, attend to my words. Turn your ear to my sayings.
lines: My son, attend to my words.
Turn your ear to my sayings.

verses.text: Let them not depart from your eyes. Keep them in the center of your heart.
lines: Let them not depart from your eyes.
Keep them in the center of your heart.

verses.text: For they are life to those who find them, and health to their whole body.
lines: For they are life to those who find them,
and health to their whole body.

verses.text: Keep your heart with all diligence, for out of it is the wellspring of life.
lines: Keep your heart with all diligence,
for out of it is the wellspring of life.

verses.text: Put away from yourself a perverse mouth. Put corrupt lips far from you.
lines: Put away from yourself a perverse mouth.
Put corrupt lips far from you.

verses.text: Let your eyes look straight ahead. Fix your gaze directly before you.
lines: Let your eyes look straight ahead.
Fix your gaze directly before you.

verses.text: Make the path of your feet level. Let all of your ways be established.
lines: Make the path of your feet level.
Let all of your ways be established.

verses.text: Don’t turn to the right hand nor to the left. Remove your foot from evil.
lines: Don’t turn to the right hand nor to the left.
Remove your foot from evil.
